title: XcodeGen Project Specification
description: Third-party editor schema for XcodeGen project.yml and project.yaml, targeting master 366592bc5be446b427fc8e2a21520344460f96ab (2026-09-13). The latest published release observed during research was 2.46.0; this schema may include changes after that release. Includes, templates and variable expansion cannot be resolved by JSON Schema. Inherited fields are checked structurally and their required-field checks are deferred. XcodeGen remains responsible for resolved references, paths, version parsing and project generation.
$comment: Sources: https://github.com/yonaskolb/XcodeGen/blob/366592bc5be446b427fc8e2a21520344460f96ab/Docs/ProjectSpec.md ; https://github.com/yonaskolb/XcodeGen/tree/366592bc5be446b427fc8e2a21520344460f96ab/Sources/ProjectSpec ; XcodeProj revision eb001108f64467b0cc7e8cbf90b3b4aaa1822cbb. Use #/$defs/projectFragment for an included file that intentionally has no name. Fixed structures reject unknown keys; settings, attributes and plist contents stay open. Only known keys receive typed :REPLACE aliases. Presence of include conservatively defers requirements, including when the include is empty or disabled. Actual merge order, empty template expansions, alias precedence and environment values must be checked by XcodeGen. Documented examples contain an invalid ExceptionBreakpoint shorthand, a target-level fileGroups key, and a tab-indented script block; the mixed flat/grouped settings example intentionally demonstrates an ignored setting. These examples are not used to broaden the accepted specification. Validation command with Ajv 8 installed: node -e 'const s=require("./xcodegen.schema.json"); const a=new (require("ajv/dist/2020").default)({strict:false,validateFormats:false}); const v=a.compile(s); for(const x of s.examples) if(!v(x)) throw Error(JSON.stringify(v.errors)); console.log("Schema and examples valid");'

variable.description: Environment or template substitution. The resolved value must satisfy the corresponding field type and enum.

version.description: Version accepted by XcodeGen's tolerant version parser. Quote version strings to avoid YAML numeric conversion.

platform.description: Target platform. With supportedDestinations, omission or an empty string resolves to auto.

destinations.description: Destination list. A target cannot combine macOS and macCatalyst.

productType.description: Product type accepted by XcodeGen and its pinned XcodeProj 9.14.0 dependency. Empty represents a legacy target; full com.apple.product-type identifiers are also accepted.

attributes.description: Xcode attributes, including nested SystemCapabilities. Keys and values are intentionally open.

configFiles.description: Build configuration name to xcconfig path.

buildSettings.description: Xcode build settings, including user-defined names and conditional keys such as EXCLUDED_ARCHS[sdk=iphonesimulator*]. XcodeGen stringifies scalars and preserves string lists.

groupedSettings.description: Grouped build settings. Mixing flat keys with this form causes XcodeGen to ignore the flat keys.

presets.description: Compatibility alias for groups. Effective when base, groups, or configs selects the grouped form.

configs.description: Configuration selector to settings. Matching is case-insensitive, with exact configuration-name matches taking priority.

settings.description: Flat build settings or grouped settings. The forms must not be mixed.

relativePaths.description: Resolve paths relative to the included file. String values are parsed as booleans after variable substitution.

enable.description: Enable this include. Supports an environment-variable expression.

oneOf.description: Included specifications, merged in order before the current specification.

pattern.description: Group name or regular expression. Omit for the main group.

fileType.description: Default source options for a file extension.

file.description: Treat the extension as a file.

createIntermediateGroups.description: Create groups for intermediate path components.

defaultConfig.description: Default build configuration. If omitted, the alphabetically first configuration is chosen.

groupSortPosition.description: Position of groups relative to files.

transitivelyLinkDependencies.description: Link and, where appropriate, embed transitive dependencies.

generateEmptyDirectories.description: Include empty directories in the project.

localPackagesGroup.description: Group for local packages; an empty string means the root.

fileTypes.description: Default source options keyed by extension.

preGenCommand.description: Shell command before generation; skipped on a cache hit.

postGenCommand.description: Shell command after generation; skipped on a cache hit.

defaultSourceDirectoryType.description: Default source directory representation. The SourceType decoder also accepts file, although the documentation lists group, folder and syncedFolder. syncedFolder requires an Xcode 16 project format.

source.description: Target source entry. Resource files belong here, optionally with buildPhase set to resources.

name.description: Display name; otherwise the last path component is used.

group.description: Parent group path, separated with slashes.

compilerFlags.description: Space-separated compiler flags or a list.

excludes.description: Exclude glob patterns relative to path. Excludes take priority over includes.

includes.description: Include glob patterns relative to path.

explicitFolders.description: Child folder patterns treated as folder references within syncedFolder.

inferDestinationFiltersByPath.description: Infer destination filters from path or filename; explicit destinationFilters takes priority.

optional.description: Allow this path to be absent.

type.description: File, group, folder reference, or Xcode 16 synchronized folder.

sources.description: One path, or a list containing paths and source objects. Although the prose mentions a single source object, the pinned Target decoder consumes only a string or an array.

dependency.description: Target dependency. Selector precedence in the decoder is target, framework, carthage, sdk, package, bundle.

package.description: Name in the project packages mapping.

embed.description: Embed the dependency; the default depends on target type.

link.description: Link the dependency; the default depends on target and dependency types.

platforms.description: Platforms for which this dependency is included.

findFrameworks.description: Carthage discovery override; otherwise inherit options.findCarthageFrameworks.

root.description: Root for an SDK framework path, for example DEVELOPER_DIR.

product.description: Single Swift package product; defaults to the package name.

products.description: Swift package products. The list takes precedence over product.

plist.description: Generated plist. path is required in the final merged target.

properties.description: Property-list keys and nested values. Contents are not limited to a fixed set of Apple keys.

buildScript.description: Run-script build phase. Provide path or script; script wins when both are present.

showEnvVars.description: Print environment variables in the build log.

basedOnDependencyAnalysis.description: Skip when inputs, outputs, and context are unchanged.

buildRule.description: Custom build rule. fileType takes precedence over filePattern; compilerSpec takes precedence over script.

legacy.description: Legacy external build target. toolPath is required after merging.

passSettings.description: Pass build settings to the external tool.

settingsTarget.description: Build or test target supplying settings to the environment.

shell.description: Shell executable; supported by the source decoder.

executionActions.description: Ordered scripts before or after a scheme action.

value.description: Variable value. XcodeGen stringifies values and converts booleans to YES or NO.

oneOf.description: Environment names to values. Entries are enabled, and values are stringified.
Environment variables with explicit enabled flags.

isShown.description: Show this scheme in the scheme list.

simulateLocation.description: Run-action location simulation. allow is required after merging.

defaultLocation.description: Predefined location name or relative GPX path. Add a custom GPX file to project fileGroups.

testPlan.description: Referenced test plan. XcodeGen does not create test-plan contents.

path.description: Path to an existing xctestplan file.

defaultPlan.description: Choose this as the default; otherwise the first plan becomes default.

qualifiedReference.description: Project or local package name followed by target name. Template expressions are resolved later.

testableTargetReference.description: Explicit target reference. Decoder precedence is project, package, local.

coverageTargets.description: Coverage targets, including local package tests.

testTarget.description: Test target and options. Selector precedence is name, local, project, package, target.

selectedTests.description: Selected tests; takes precedence over skippedTests.

run.description: Scheme Run action. Only fields consumed by the Run decoder are exposed.

config.description: Build configuration. Defaults to debug for run/test/analyze and release for profile/archive.

enableGPUValidationMode.description: Metal API validation. Legacy enabled, extended, and disabled strings remain supported.

stopOnEveryMainThreadCheckerIssue.description: Stop at each Main Thread Checker issue.

executable.description: Target to launch. Defaults to the first runnable build target, or the first build target.

customWorkingDirectory.description: Working directory for the launched executable.

config.description: Build configuration. Defaults to debug for run/test/analyze and release for profile/archive.
Build configuration. Defaults to debug for run/test/analyze and release for profile/archive.

analyze.description: Scheme Analyze action. The pinned decoder consumes only config.

config.description: Build configuration. Defaults to debug for run/test/analyze and release for profile/archive.
Build configuration. Defaults to debug for run/test/analyze and release for profile/archive.

revealArchiveInOrganizer.description: Reveal the finished archive in Organizer.

buildTypes.description: Build selection. String presets are all, none, testing, and indexing; the pinned decoder treats other strings as all. Arrays and maps select individual actions.

build.description: Scheme Build action. targets is required after merging.

targets.description: Target name to enabled build actions.

runPostActionsOnFailure.description: Run post-actions even after a build failure.

scheme.description: Scheme or reusable scheme fragment. Required fields are checked on standalone non-template schemes.

targetScheme.description: Convenience scheme generation for a target.

configVariants.description: Configuration name variants. Despite the documentation's required marker, the decoder defaults to an empty list.

stopOnEveryMainThreadCheckerIssue.description: Stop at each Main Thread Checker issue.

target.description: Native target or target template. Resources use sources; target dependencies use dependencies.

productName.description: Product filename; otherwise use the resolved target name.

deploymentTarget.description: Scalar native-target version, or platform map for expanded multiplatform targets. A destination map is documented for supportedDestinations but the pinned native-target decoder does not consume it.

directlyEmbedCarthageDependencies.description: Embed Carthage frameworks directly. Default depends on target platform and type.

requiresObjCLinking.description: Add -ObjC to dependents; defaults to true for static libraries.

onlyCopyFilesOnInstall.description: Copy embedded frameworks and extensions only during installation.

postCompileScripts.description: Scripts after the Compile Sources phase.

putResourcesBeforeSourcesBuildPhase.description: Place Copy Resources before Compile Sources.

targets.description: Target dependencies. The pinned decoder permits omission.

package.description: Local or remote Swift package. Remote requirement precedence: exactVersion, version, revision, branch, minVersion+maxVersion, minorVersion, majorVersion, from.

url.description: Remote Git URL, including HTTPS or SSH.

github.description: GitHub owner/repository shortcut; takes precedence over url.

path.description: Local package directory containing Package.swift; selects a local package.

group.description: Local package group; an empty string means the project root.

excludeFromProject.description: Exclude a local package from the generated project.

branch.description: Git branch. The decoder also converts numeric YAML values to strings.

revision.description: Git revision. The decoder also converts numeric YAML values to strings.

conveyanceType.description: Log conveyance; case-insensitive console or speak.

waitUntilDone.description: Wait for the shell command to finish.

type.description: Breakpoint type. Use Exception, not the invalid ExceptionBreakpoint shorthand in the documentation example.

projectFragment.description: Project fragment. Bind #/$defs/projectFragment for an included file that intentionally omits required project fields. Known field types are still checked.

configs.description: Configuration name to debug, release, or another string for no presets.

fileGroups.description: Files displayed in the project hierarchy without target membership.

localPackages.description: Legacy local package paths. Use packages for traits, group, and exclusion options.

completePackage.description: Required fields for a standalone package. Includes may supply these fields in project fragments.

completeScheme.description: Requirements for a standalone scheme without inherited templates.

completeTarget.description: Required fields and local consistency checks for a standalone target without inherited templates.
